title: Conversation 2026-10-28: the specification is readable by agents

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner brought SRS into a claude.ai conversation; claude.ai could not read the published specification at srs.semanticops.com (one 514 KB file, cut off at about 117k characters, no llms.txt). The owner called it a core Third-party-ready requirement and a bug: the spec must be agent readable, which is the point of SRS. Planning the response, the owner ruled that the spec / unified distinction lost in the RFC-042 restructure comes back: the spec carries only what is needed to use it, the unified file carries the rationale.
